text: Very good service doctor very nice and helpful .by the way very reasonable price

On my first visit, I had influenza B. The doctor personally took a swab from the patient, asked detailed questions, and prescribed high-quality medication. The clinic was clean, and they had disease screening measures in place. The doctor even went outside to see patients, which was great as it prevented the spread of germs in the air-conditioned room.
The assistant was terrible, to be honest. Asking a 4-month-old baby to weigh something for an adult...is that even realistic? Her language and demeanor were awful.
